waves.name: Account inquiry (TRNR)
waves.rationale: PROGR only reads ACCTDAT and returns (app/cbl/PROGR.cbl:7). It is the cheapest unit to prove the toolchain and the comparison harness on. The VSAM file stays where it is, so the ported reader reads records the legacy writer still produces. That is a sound wave only if the ported reader decodes the COMP-3 balance identically (app/cpy/ACCTREC.cpy:3).
waves.unblocks: The decoded ACCTREC layout and the record-level harness that wave 2 reuses.

waves.name: Account write (TRNW)
waves.rationale: PROGW is the only writer of ACCTDAT (app/cbl/PROGW.cbl:7), and PROGR reads what it writes through the same copybook (modernization-assessment/graph.json contract edge PROGW to PROGR). Once it moves, the dataset has a single owner and the VSAM file can be retired behind it. The cutover has to flip the file owner and the writer together.
waves.unblocks: Retiring the shared KSDS, the only shared state in the tree.
